title: Guest Lecture Moved
transcript: Hi everyone, quick reminder about tomorrow's guest lecture. Dr. Amara Okafor from the city planning office is still coming, but we've moved the talk from Room 210 to the Hartley Auditorium, since more than a hundred people signed up. It starts at four, not three thirty, so she can finish a meeting downtown first. Please bring your questions about public transit design. She's saving the last twenty minutes for discussion.
